jobs.role:
Strategy/Business Planning

 Supports the annual business planning process, identifying and prioritizing required work effort to continually advance our strategic pillars in conjunction with the portfolio leaders
 Operationalize the Audit Technology strategy into clear priorities, roadmaps, and delivery plans across all pillars
 Ensure alignment between national priorities and regional priorities and execution, and transformation initiatives
 Drive structured business planning cycles (annual, quarterly) tied to measurable outcomes 
 Develops & manages regular dashboard reporting mechanism to track progress, status of action items and risks of strategic initiatives
 Meets regularly with CTO and National Audit S&O Managing Director to ensure we are advancing at right pace 
 Sets up and manages the regular cadence for Audit Technology & Transformation leadership meetings including preparation of meeting materials and pre-work
 Project manages the portfolio of work to advance each respective strategic priority
 Works fluidly with the priority owner/sponsor to identify and advance the 6-8 week, 6M and 12-18M desired outcomes
 Creates work breakdown schedules to manage work streams and keep teams on track
 Facilitates update meetings with key stakeholders and manages action items to drive progress

Audit Technology and Transformation 

 Work directly with the CTO to develop, and execute the Audit Technology and Transformation strategy and initiatives for National Audit including:
 Partner with Transformation Office and Change leads to ensure successful rollout and adoption of technologies and capabilities 
 Embed structured change management approaches across initiatives 
 Monitor adoption metrics and intervene where execution gaps exist
 Work with the Lead and ensure proper implementation of technologies/product development for the Audit practice 
 Lead project management for the Audit Technology and Transformation team ensuring that timelines and milestones are adhered to, targets are met, and risks are appropriately flagged
 Provide support to the CTO to prioritize initiatives and continuously advance team objectives 
 Develop internal dashboards, benchmarks, and scorecards to track progress, status of action items and risks of strategic initiatives.

What you bring to this role

 Leader with experience in strategy, operations, or transformation within a complex, matrixed environment
 Strong understanding of technology-enabled transformation (e.g. data, AI, platforms)
 Experience supporting senior executives (e.g. CTO, COO, or equivalent)
 Clear understanding of functional and regional business priorities 
 Superior Project and Stakeholder Management skills with strong organizational ability
 Demonstrated ability to work in a consultative manner and deliver strategic ideas and solutions
 Change leadership and organizational effectiveness expertise, ability to act as a change agent and integrator to connect the dots, assert ideas and influence others
 Ability to resolve conflict and work under pressure and prioritize competing demands
 Highly motivated and takes initiative
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including good interpersonal skills
 Strong presentation and facilitation skills

 
KPMG Ontario Pay Range Information
The expected base salary range for this position is $122,000 to $162,500 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.
 
KPMG BC Region Pay Range Information   
The expected base salary range for this position is $115,000 to $150,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

jobs.role:
Strategy/Business Planning

 Supports the annual business planning process, identifying and prioritizing required work effort to continually advance our strategic pillars in conjunction with the portfolio leaders
 Operationalize the Audit Technology strategy into clear priorities, roadmaps, and delivery plans across all pillars
 Ensure alignment between national priorities and regional priorities and execution, and transformation initiatives
 Drive structured business planning cycles (annual, quarterly) tied to measurable outcomes 
 Develops & manages regular dashboard reporting mechanism to track progress, status of action items and risks of strategic initiatives
 Meets regularly with CTO and National Audit S&O Managing Director to ensure we are advancing at right pace 
 Sets up and manages the regular cadence for Audit Technology & Transformation leadership meetings including preparation of meeting materials and pre-work
 Project manages the portfolio of work to advance each respective strategic priority
 Works fluidly with the priority owner/sponsor to identify and advance the 6-8 week, 6M and 12-18M desired outcomes
 Creates work breakdown schedules to manage work streams and keep teams on track
 Facilitates update meetings with key stakeholders and manages action items to drive progress

Audit Technology and Transformation 

 Work directly with the CTO to develop, and execute the Audit Technology and Transformation strategy and initiatives for National Audit including:
 Partner with Transformation Office and Change leads to ensure successful rollout and adoption of technologies and capabilities 
 Embed structured change management approaches across initiatives 
 Monitor adoption metrics and intervene where execution gaps exist
 Work with the Lead and ensure proper implementation of technologies/product development for the Audit practice 
 Lead project management for the Audit Technology and Transformation team ensuring that timelines and milestones are adhered to, targets are met, and risks are appropriately flagged
 Provide support to the CTO to prioritize initiatives and continuously advance team objectives 
 Develop internal dashboards, benchmarks, and scorecards to track progress, status of action items and risks of strategic initiatives.

What you bring to this role

 Leader with experience in strategy, operations, or transformation within a complex, matrixed environment
 Strong understanding of technology-enabled transformation (e.g. data, AI, platforms)
 Experience supporting senior executives (e.g. CTO, COO, or equivalent)
 Clear understanding of functional and regional business priorities 
 Superior Project and Stakeholder Management skills with strong organizational ability
 Demonstrated ability to work in a consultative manner and deliver strategic ideas and solutions
 Change leadership and organizational effectiveness expertise, ability to act as a change agent and integrator to connect the dots, assert ideas and influence others
 Ability to resolve conflict and work under pressure and prioritize competing demands
 Highly motivated and takes initiative
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including good interpersonal skills
 Strong presentation and facilitation skills

The selected candidate must demonstrate excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain and simplify complex audit and reporting matters for diverse audiences. Proficiency in English is required, as the position involves communicating and delivering presentations to clients and stakeholders at KPMG Canada in English‑speaking regions of Canada.
 
KPMG Ontario - Pay Range Information
The expected base salary range for this position is $122,000 to $162,500 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.
 
KPMG BC Region - Pay Range Information   
The expected base salary range for this position is $115,000 to $150,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program. 
 
Providing you with the support you need to be at your best
 

Our Values, The KPMG Way
Integrity, we do what is right | Excellence, we never stop learning and improving | Courage, we think and act boldly | Together, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better, we do what matters
 
KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.
 
Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process
 
At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.
 
AI Usage
 
We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.
 
We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.
